title: Attempt Event
description: One row per attempt — the load-bearing artifact of the student model (student-model doc §9). Everything the model knows is computable from this log; anything not in this log is uncomputable later. Field names are ASCII spellings of the doc's θ (theta_before / theta_after). Compliance: pseudonymous student IDs, no free-text fields that could carry PII (COPPA / DPDP / UK AADC).

student_id.description: Pseudonymous student identifier (§9). Nothing in the schema requires identifying a child.

session_id.description: Session identifier; powers the abandonment guard (§3) and session-level analyses (§9).

item_instance_id.description: The concrete served instance from the bank's materialized pool (§9; core doc §5.1).

bank_version.description: Bank build the Orchestrator pinned when serving (§9; core doc §5.3).

variant_signature.description: Serving-integrity contract R2, R8, KTD2: the served instance's content-based identity (item-instance.schema.json's variant_signature), copied verbatim at serve time — the seen filter and ingest validation key on this, not item_instance_id, so seen-state survives a bank rebuild (KD4).

consumer_id.description: Serving-integrity contract R7, KTD2: which orchestrator submitted this event — the reference orchestrator stamps constants.CONSUMER_ID_INTERNAL; external orchestrators are stamped by the MCP server from its own configuration, never from the caller's payload. Makes per-consumer repeat-flag rates attributable.

graph_version.description: Migration correctness — every update is replayable against the graph structure the state was earned under (§9; §8).

skill_ids.description: What was measured (§9). Multi-skill items update all listed skills on success at half weight (§3).

question_type.description: The response format served (§9) — needed because guessing adjustment and certification depend on format class (§3, §7). Keep this enum in sync with item-record.schema.json's question_type (core doc §2.7 type taxonomy) — the same string values classify both, and format-class checks (LOW_GUESS_FORMATS, MCQ4_QUESTION_TYPE) match on them exactly.

depth_served.description: Depth on the D ∈ [0,1] scale at which the item was served (§9; core doc §2.3).

b_prior_at_serve.description: Item difficulty estimate b at serve time, on the θ-aligned scale (§9; §2). What was measured.

exam_context.description: Exam-context wrapper under which the item was served (§9; core doc §2.10). Null for ordinary practice.

language.description: Language the instance was rendered in (§9; core doc §2.8).

locale.description: Locale pack used for dressing (§9; core doc §1.5).

response_parsed.description: The machine-parsed response used for scoring (§9).

misconception_id.description: Distractor tag matched (§9; core doc §2.4). Nullable — an untagged wrong answer is diagnostic noise (core doc §2.5).

hints_used.description: Assistance evidence (§9). Hint-assisted corrects move θ at reduced weight and never certify (core doc §2.3).

hint_auto_offered.description: Whether the engine proactively offered hint 1 at ~1.5× estimated_time_sec (§9; core doc §2.3).

timed_out.description: Timeouts score 0 only if the student was engaged — see the abandonment guard (§9; §3).

context.description: Selection-effect bookkeeping (§9). lesson attempts (guided practice inside a lesson, core doc §6) update θ at weight 0.25 and never certify.

theta_before.description: θ before the update (doc's θ_before) — model auditability, every update replayable (§9). Unbounded above the [0,1] difficulty scale (§2).

theta_after.description: θ after the update (doc's θ_after) — model auditability (§9).

n_before.description: Effective evidence count before the update (§9; §4).
